title: Families that have Benefited from Home Ownership Plus Education Scheme
what_it_is: Families that have Benefited from Home Ownership Plus Education Scheme

sections.label: Home Ownership Plus Education benefits
sections.summary: The Minister lists benefits of the Home Ownership Plus Education scheme, including training, employment, housing, utilities, education, mentoring and family planning incentives.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development to date, how many families have benefited from the Home Ownership Plus Education scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
sentences.text: I think Mr Gan is asking what the families have benefited so far from these programmes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: It goes beyond his original question, but I would just like to share, with this opportunity, that the benefits include training incentives, employment incentives, conditional housing grant, utilities grant, education bursaries, mentoring and family support as well as family planning incentives.

sections.label: Beneficiaries exiting scheme
sections.summary: The Minister states that there are beneficiaries who have exited the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Again, it goes beyond the Member's original question but I would like to share that, indeed, there are beneficiaries who have exited the scheme.
